mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM org_class WHERE status=1) AS classCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE role='teacher' AND status=1) AS teacherCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE role='student' AND status=1) AS studentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE status=1) AS courseCount, -- 选课率：已选课学生 / 总有效学生 *100 ROUND(IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FROM selection_record WHERE status=1) *100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE role='student' AND status=1),0),0),2) AS selectionRate, -- 考勤合格率：签到成功记录 / 全部考勤记录 *100 ROUND(IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_record WHERE status=1)*100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_record),0),0),2) AS attendanceRate

SELECT oc.name AS collegeName, COUNT(su.id) AS studentNum FROM org_college oc LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON oc.id = su.college_id AND su.role='student' AND su.status=1 WHERE oc.status=1 GROUP BY oc.id, oc.name ORDER BY oc.sort
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE role='teacher' AND status=1) AS teacherCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE role='student' AND status=1) AS studentCount

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS courseCount, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.student_id) AS studentTotal, ROUND(AVG(ss.score),2) AS avgScore FROM course c LEFT JOIN selection_record sr ON c.id = sr.course_id AND sr.status = 1 LEFT JOIN student_score ss ON c.id = ss.course_id AND ss.status = 1 WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND c.status = 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ss.score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SIGNED) AS s0, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ss.score BETWEEN 60 AND 69 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SIGNED) AS s60, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ss.score BETWEEN 70 AND 79 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SIGNED) AS s70, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ss.score BETWEEN 80 AND 89 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SIGNED) AS s80, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ss.score >= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SIGNED) AS s90 FROM student_score ss WHERE ss.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND ss.status = 1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ats.session_date, '%m-%d') AS day, ROUND( IFNULL( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_record ar WHERE ar.session_id = ats.id AND ar.status = 1) * 100.0 / NULLIF( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user su WHERE su.class_id = ats.class_id AND su.role = 'student' AND su.status = 1), 0 ), 0 ), 2 ) AS rate FROM attendance_session ats WHERE ats.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND ats.session_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND ats.session_date < CURDATE() GROUP BY ats.id, ats.session_date ORDER BY ats.session_date ASC
SELECT ROUND(SUM(ss.score * c.credit) / SUM(c.credit), 2) FROM student_score ss JOIN course c ON ss.course_id = c.id WHERE ss.student_id = #{studentId} AND ss.status = 1 AND ss.score >= 60
SELECT ROUND(SUM(c.credit), 2) FROM student_score ss JOIN course c ON ss.course_id = c.id WHERE ss.student_id = #{studentId} AND ss.status = 1 AND ss.score >= 60
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_score ss WHERE ss.student_id = #{studentId} AND ss.status = 1 AND ss.score < 60
SELECT c.name AS course_name, ss.score FROM student_score ss JOIN course c ON ss.course_id = c.id WHERE ss.student_id = #{studentId} AND ss.status = 1 ORDER BY ss.create_time DESC

SELECT c.semester, ROUND(AVG(ss.score), 2) AS avg_score FROM student_score ss JOIN course c ON ss.course_id = c.id WHERE ss.student_id = #{studentId} AND ss.status = 1 AND c.semester IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.semester ORDER BY c.semester

SELECT c.name AS course_name, ss.usual_score, ss.final_score, ss.score FROM student_score ss JOIN course c ON ss.course_id = c.id WHERE ss.student_id = #{studentId} AND ss.status = 1 ORDER BY ss.create_time DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT ROUND( COUNT(CASE WHEN ar.status = 1 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2 ) AS rate FROM attendance_record ar JOIN attendance_session a_s ON ar.session_id = a_s.id WHERE ar.student_id = #{studentId} AND a_s.session_date >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01') AND a_s.session_date <= LAST_DAY(NOW())

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a_s.session_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND( COUNT(CASE WHEN ar.status = 1 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2 ) AS rate FROM attendance_record ar JOIN attendance_session a_s ON ar.session_id = a_s.id WHERE ar.student_id = #{studentId} AND a_s.session_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 5 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(a_s.session_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.real_name, u.gender, u.email, u.phone, u.avatar, u.class_id, c.name AS class_name, u.major_id, m.name AS major_name, u.college_id, col.name AS college_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN org_class c ON u.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN org_major m ON u.major_id = m.id LEFT JOIN org_college col ON u.college_id = col.id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.role = 'student'
